raw_text: No material conditional bias was identified from the validation procedures. · Previously MRE was not estimated, mining also was not performed Moisture · Whether the tonnages are estimated on a dry basis or with natural moisture, and the method of determination of the moisture content. · From 10.5 to 14.2%, average 13.3% Cut-off parameters · The basis of the adopted cut-off grade(s) or quality parameters applied. · The Mineral Resource is reported above a 200 ppm TREO-Ce for open pit method of mining and value of REO 5.27 US$ in individual operation ISR cell for covering of processing cost with zero profit cut-off. · The Mineral Resource cut-off should therefore not be considered directly comparable with conventional excavation-based clay-hosted REE projects because the Wudinna resource is being assessed for both extraction through ISR and open cut mining methods. · The Competent Person considers that the Mineral Resource as reported fulfills the reasonable prospects for eventual economic extraction requirement for reporting Mineral Resources in accordance with the JORC Code.
